Question: Let \(A,\) \(M,\) and \(C\) be nonnegative integers such that \(A + M + C = 12.\) What is the maximum value of \[ \begin{aligned} &A \cdot M \cdot C + A \cdot M \\ &\quad {}+ M \cdot C + C \cdot A? \end{aligned} \]
